name: Bunbun Tower
source:
Bunbun returns to work at the cafe tower after she completed her therapy. The problem is that she never did return. Instead, Bunbun getting stuck in a loop of horror awaiting her with monsters and her faceless doppelgangers hanging around. Will she escape from the madness and find her memory fragments to understand what is going on?

(Taken from [url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/bunbun-tower]Itch.io[/url])
translation:
完成治疗后，邦邦回到咖啡馆塔楼工作。问题是她再也没有回来。相反，Bunbun陷入了一个等待着她的恐怖循环中，周围有怪物和她的不露面的分身。她能否逃离疯狂并找到自己的记忆碎片来了解到底发生了什么？

（取自 [url=https://namelessdistrict.itch.io/bunbun-tower]Itch.io[/url]）
